decisions.statement: The marker the deploy writes is the only evidence a folder is the deploy's to take away.
A folder carrying the marker that no addon page names any more is taken away.
A folder carrying no marker is left where it is, whatever that folder is named.
A folder the sweep could not read is left where it is.
A folder a manifest names as a sibling counts as shipped.
A sweep that finds no addon at all takes nothing away.
The sweep says how many folders it weighed and how many it took away.
A folder that would not go is refused rather than reported gone.
Nothing here is compiled and nothing here is placed.

definition: the folders in the game the deploy wrote for addons it ships no longer, taken away
